order.description:
Specifies the order to return Objs.  Default if not specified is by "id".

Supports multiple fields (e.g. "field1, field2") and descending order per field (e.g. "field1, descending(field2)").

If {@link limit} is set to -1, and order is specified as "<none>", then no order will be applied at the database.
This should only be done if its impact is fully understood as it may help performance in some cases and hurt it in
others.  If you aren't sure, DON'T USE IT.

offset.description: Offset to use for paged reads.

limit.description:
Maximum number of Objs to return (starting from {@link offset}).  If there are fewer rows than were requested, only
those will be returned.  If there are additional rows beyond what was requested, then {@link FetchResult.hasMore}
will be set to true.

-1 returns all.

queryKind.description:
Kind of query
"match": full-text search (Word, Phrase, Sentence)
"term": term search (Single word)

expr.description:
Searchable fields queried using string serialized expr
Ex: "firstName=='Adam' && lastName=='Smith'" Field specific query
Note that for the query Expr, only infix equality (==) expressions and (a.matches(b)) function call expressions
separated by (&& or ||) are currently supported.

query.description:
Searchable fields queried using queryText
Ex: "'Adam Smith'" Full text search across all fields.

fieldBoost.description: Allows the score contribution to be boosted when the corresponding field is matched

period.description: Period for the search query. The data will be searched for the period specified ending at the current time.

fuzziness.description:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Damerau%E2%80%93Levenshtein_distance
Allows the user to specify the maximum Damerau-Levenshtein edit distance for fuzzy queries; defaults to
“-1”, which uses the default ElasticSearch behavior (i.e. “Auto” à sets to 0 for strings of 1/2 chars,
1 for strings of 3/4/5 chars, and 2 for strings of 5+ chars)

searchFields.description: The fields on which to execute a search query. If not specified, all fields will be retrieved from the SearchStore.

title:
Options to pass to a search query, used to specify details of the search query
Support for basic full-text search
name: SearchQuerySpec
